Therianthrope

A Therianthrope carries the curse of the werebeast — a slow transformation of body and instinct that grants power at the price of control. The curse spreads through its bite beneath the light of the Planar Tear.

Therianthrope DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier.

Advancement Table

StageNameFeaturesControl PointsWild RegenerationAbility Floor
1AfflictedBestial Flaw, Therianthrope Branch, Unwilling Transformation——14
2SavageControlling the Curse, Wild Regeneration11d414
3FeralFlaw Mitigation I, Bestial Aspect (branch)11d414
4PrimalFlaw Mitigation II, Feral Speed, Empowered Transformation I21d616
5AdaptedFlaw Mitigation III, branch feature21d616
6AwakenedFlaw Mitigation IV, Empowered Transformation II31d816
7PackbornFlaw Mitigation V, branch feature31d818
8AlphaFlaw Mitigation VI, Empowered Transformation III, Predator's Resurgence41d1018
9DireFlaw Mitigation VII, branch feature41d1018
10ApexFlaw Mitigation VIII52d620

Stage Features

Stage 1 — Bestial Flaws

The curse affects both mind and body. Choose one of the following flaws: Dominance; Violent; Timidity; Nightmares; Possessive; The Hunt; Restlessness; Feral; Picky Eater; Paranoia.

Stage 1 — Therianthrope Branch

Choose the branch of your curse — Bear, Fox, Raven, Tiger, Shark, Snake, or Wolf — determined by the Therianthrope that cursed you. Your branch determines your forms, your key ability, your alignment while transformed, and your branch features.

Stage 1 — Unwilling Transformation

The curse overwhelms your body at times of great stress, or when the moon is fullest, forcing you to transform.

Triggers. When your hit points are reduced below half your maximum, or when you see an ally reduced to 0 hit points, you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your Therianthrope DC or transform into your Hybrid Form for up to 10 minutes. During that time you must attack the source of the damage. If you are reduced to 0 hit points, the transformation ends.

Planar Tear. For three nights each month the Planar Tear bathes the world in magical light. When it occurs you must make the same saving throw: on a failure you transform into your Hybrid Form, and on a success into your Animal Form, remaining transformed until morning.

When you revert to your normal form after an Unwilling Transformation, you gain 1 level of Exhaustion. While transformed, you ignore all levels of Exhaustion.

When one of these triggers occurs, roll the appropriate saving throw using the activities on this feature; on a failure, use the Transform activity to assume your Hybrid Form.

Therianthrope DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier.

Stage 2 — Controlling the Curse & Wild Regeneration

You have gained a small measure of control over the curse. You gain 1 Control Point, which you can spend to transform into your Animal Form as an Action using the activity on this feature. You regain all expended Control Points when you finish a Long Rest. Your Control Point maximum increases as you gain Stages (@scale.therianthrope.control-points).

A Controlled Transformation lasts a number of hours equal to half your Stage (rounded down). It ends early if you are reduced to 0 hit points or if you dismiss it as a Bonus Action. When the duration would expire, you can spend 1 additional Control Point to extend it by the same duration. Reverting from any transformation inflicts 1 level of Exhaustion; while transformed you ignore all Exhaustion.

While transformed, when you take damage that is not silvered, you can use your Reaction to harden your flesh and regenerate, regaining hit points equal to a roll of @scale.therianthrope.wild-regen.

Stage 3 — Flaw Mitigation & Bestial Aspect

Your growing mastery lets you blunt the curse's compulsions. This feature improves as you gain Stages:

  • Stage 3. When reduced below half your hit point maximum would trigger an Unwilling Transformation, you can instead spend 1 Control Point to transform via Controlled Transformation.
  • Stage 4. The above also applies when witnessing an ally reduced to 0 hit points.
  • Stage 5. During the Planar Tear you can spend 1 Control Point to automatically succeed on the saving throw, transforming into your Animal Form.
  • Stage 6. You have advantage on the saving throw triggered by being reduced below half your hit point maximum.
  • Stage 7. You have advantage on that save and on the save triggered by witnessing an ally reduced to 0 hit points.
  • Stage 8. An Unwilling Transformation no longer forces you to attack the damage's source.
  • Stage 9. At the end of each of your turns during an Unwilling Transformation you can repeat the saving throw, ending the transformation on a success.
  • Stage 10. You can choose to succeed on any saving throw against your Unwilling Transformation.

Each branch grants a different Bestial Aspect at Stage 3.

Stage 4 — Feral Speed & Empowered Transformation

While transformed, your speed increases by 10 feet.

Your transformations grow more potent:

  • Stage 4 (I). Your natural weapons count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical damage, except against other Therianthropes.
  • Stage 6 (II). Your signature attack deals extra damage equal to your Constitution modifier.
  • Stage 8 (III). The extra damage applies to all your natural weapon attacks while transformed. In addition, when you take the Attack action using Therianthrope natural weapons, you can make one additional natural weapon attack as a Bonus Action.

Stage 8 — Predator's Resurgence

Once per Long Rest while not transformed, when you are reduced to 0 hit points you can use your Reaction to drop to 1 hit point instead, regain hit points equal to your Stage, and immediately trigger an Unwilling Transformation as though the damage source had reduced you below half your hit point maximum.

Branches

Bear

Key Ability: Strength   Transformed Alignment: Chaotic Good

Animal Form: size lg, speed walk 40 ft., climb 30 ft.; attacks: Bite (1d8), Claws (2d4).

Hybrid Form: size lg, speed walk 30 ft.; attacks: Claw (2d4), Bite (1d10).

Bestial Aspect (S3): Keen smell. While transformed, you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell and on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track creatures.

Ursine Grip (S5). When you hit a creature with your Claw attack while transformed, that creature is also grappled (escape DC equals your Therianthrope DC). You can have only one creature grappled in this way at a time.

Enduring Hide (S7). When you transform, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Stage plus your Constitution modifier.

Maul (S9). Once per turn while transformed, when you hit the same creature with a second natural weapon attack in the same turn, the attack deals an extra 2d8 damage and the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your Therianthrope DC or have the Prone condition.

Fox

Key Ability: Dexterity   Transformed Alignment: Chaotic Neutral

Animal Form: size sm, speed walk 40 ft.; attacks: Bite (1d4).

Hybrid Form: size sm, speed walk 45 ft.; attacks: Claw (1d6), Bite (1d8).

Bestial Aspect (S3): Keen hearing and smell. While transformed, you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

Cunning Escape (S5). While transformed, you can take the Disengage action as a Bonus Action.

Slippery (S7). While transformed, opportunity attacks made against you have disadvantage.

Ninefold Wiles (S9). When you roll Initiative, you can use your Reaction to transform. If you would be Surprised, spending this Reaction prevents it. You cannot be Surprised while transformed.

Raven

Key Ability: Dexterity   Transformed Alignment: Lawful Good

Animal Form: size tiny, speed walk 10 ft., fly 60 ft.; attacks: Peck (1).

Hybrid Form: size sm, speed walk 25 ft., fly 30 ft.; attacks: Talon (1d6), Beak (1d6).

Bestial Aspect (S3): Mimicry. While transformed, you can mimic simple sounds and voices you have heard; a creature can tell the sound is imitation with a successful Wisdom (Insight) check against your Therianthrope DC.

Ominous Gaze (S5). When you hit a creature with a natural weapon attack while transformed, you can fix it with an ominous gaze. Until the end of your next turn, that creature has disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against your Therianthrope DC.

Flyby (S7). While transformed, you do not provoke opportunity attacks when you fly out of a creature's reach.

Death's Witness (S9). When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points while transformed, each enemy creature of your choice within 10 feet of it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your Therianthrope DC or have the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn.

Tiger

Key Ability: Strength   Transformed Alignment: Neutral

Animal Form: size lg, speed walk 40 ft.; attacks: Claw (1d8), Bite (1d10).

Hybrid Form: size med, speed walk 40 ft.; attacks: Claw (2d4), Bite (1d10).

Bestial Aspect (S3): Keen smell. While transformed, you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell and on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made in natural terrain.

Pounce (S5). While transformed, if you move at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hit it with a natural weapon attack, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your Therianthrope DC or have the Prone condition.

Stalker's Prowl (S7). While transformed, once per turn when you hit a creature with a natural weapon attack while you are hidden from it, the attack deals an extra 2d8 damage. At Stage 9 this extra damage increases to 2d12.

Apex Strike (S9). While transformed, your natural weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20. In addition, the extra damage from Stalker's Prowl increases to 2d12.

Shark

Key Ability: Strength   Transformed Alignment: Neutral Evil

Animal Form: size lg, speed swim 40 ft.; attacks: Bite (2d6).

Hybrid Form: size lg, speed walk 30 ft., swim 40 ft.; attacks: Bite (2d6), Claw (1d10).

Bestial Aspect (S3): Blood in the water. While transformed, you gain blindsight out to 30 feet while you are underwater.

Blood Frenzy (S5). While transformed, you have advantage on attack rolls against creatures that are below their hit point maximum.

Rending Bite (S7). While transformed, when you hit a creature with your Bite, it cannot regain hit points until the end of your next turn.

Feeding Frenzy (S9). While transformed, when you deal damage with your Bite to a creature, you regain hit points equal to half the damage dealt.

Snake

Key Ability: Dexterity   Transformed Alignment: Lawful Evil

Animal Form: size sm, speed walk 30 ft., swim 30 ft.; attacks: Bite (1d4).

Hybrid Form: size sm, speed walk 30 ft.; attacks: Bite (1d6).

Bestial Aspect (S3): Heat-sensing pits. While transformed, you gain blindsight out to 10 feet.

Venomous Bite (S5). While transformed, when you hit a creature with your Bite, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your Therianthrope DC or have the Poisoned condition and take an extra 2d4 poison damage. At Stage 7 the extra damage increases to 2d6, and at Stage 9 to 2d8.

Shed Skin (S7). While transformed, you can use a Bonus Action to end one effect on yourself that is grappling or restraining you or reducing your speed. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until that transformation ends.

Virulent Venom (S9). While transformed, once per round when a creature fails the saving throw against your Venomous Bite, it takes the venom damage again at the start of its next turn.

Wolf

Key Ability: Strength   Transformed Alignment: Chaotic Evil

Animal Form: size med, speed walk 40 ft.; attacks: Bite (2d4).

Hybrid Form: size med, speed walk 40 ft.; attacks: Bite (1d8), Claw (1d6).

Bestial Aspect (S3): Keen hearing and smell. While transformed, you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

Trip (S5). While transformed, when you hit a creature with your Bite, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your Therianthrope DC or have the Prone condition.

Pack Tactics (S7). While transformed, you have advantage on attack rolls against a creature if at least one of your allies is within 5 feet of it and that ally does not have the Incapacitated condition.

Alpha Howl (S9). While transformed, you can use a Bonus Action to loose a commanding howl. Each ally of your choice within 30 feet that can hear you gains temporary hit points equal to your Stage and advantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of your next turn.

Milestones

Stages are gated by Advancement Milestones. Complete all regular milestones to advance; at even Stages you also resolve the Callings below.

Stage 1: Transform once after being reduced below half your hit point maximum. Transform once after witnessing an ally reduced to 0 hit points. Transform 3 times due to the Planar Tear.

Stage 2: Spend 10 Control Points. Mitigate a total of 30 damage using Wild Regeneration. Plus the Callings.

Stage 3: Take control of an Unwilling Transformation 3 times.

Stage 4: Take control of an Unwilling Transformation 5 times. Travel 80 feet in one turn while transformed during Initiative. Plus the Callings.

Stage 5: Spend 3 Control Points to automatically succeed on saving throws during the Planar Tear.

Stage 6: Hit 10 different enemy creatures with your Bite. Succeed on 5 saving throws to resist Unwilling Transformation (any trigger). Plus the Callings.

Stage 7: Succeed on 10 saving throws to resist Unwilling Transformation (any trigger).

Stage 8: Make 10 extra attacks with Empowered Transformation III. Trigger Predator's Resurgence once. Plus the Callings.

Stage 9: End an Unwilling Transformation 5 times.

Stage 10: Plus the Callings.

Callings & Gifts

At Stages 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 you may commit to a Calling — Control or Embrace — by completing its milestone. Each grants a gift: Minor at S2–4, Minor or Major at S6–8, and any tier at S10. The Grand gift requires all four Minor and Major gifts of that side.

Control

  • Growing Control (minor). Your maximum number of Control Points increases by 1.
  • Extended Form (minor). Your Controlled Transformation lasts a number of hours equal to your Stage instead of half your Stage.
  • Adorned Beast (minor). When you use Controlled Transformation, your equipment continues to be worn if your new form could physically wear it. You cannot benefit from magic items through this feature unless you also have the Hybrid Mastery gift.
  • Careful Control (minor). Whenever you finish a Short Rest, you regain 1 spent Control Point.
  • Tireless Beast (major). You no longer gain a level of Exhaustion when a Controlled Transformation ends.
  • Anchored Mind (major). You retain your languages, proficiencies, and class features during Controlled Transformation. You still cannot cast spells that require Somatic components.
  • Hybrid Mastery (major). Your Hybrid Form becomes an option for Controlled Transformation. Because the Hybrid Form has the physique for it, you can benefit from attuned magic items and their properties while transformed; you still cannot use any item your current form lacks the physique to use.
  • Tapped Instinct (major). While not transformed, you can spend 1 Control Point as a Bonus Action to heighten your body's capabilities for 1 minute, gaining the benefits of Bestial Aspect, Wild Regeneration, and Feral Speed.
  • True Mastery (grand). You have mastered the curse. Unwilling Transformation triggers only from the Planar Tear; you never gain Exhaustion from transforming; you can use Controlled Transformation as a Bonus Action; and your maximum number of Control Points increases by 1.

Embrace

  • Animal Rage (minor). Your maximum number of Control Points is reduced by 1. Choose one natural weapon from your Hybrid Form; you gain access to it while not transformed.
  • Savage Hunger (minor). Your maximum number of Control Points is reduced by 1. Once per turn while transformed, when you hit with a natural weapon attack, the attack deals an extra 1d6 damage.
  • Ravenous Regeneration (minor). Your maximum number of Control Points is reduced by 1. Wild Regeneration heals an extra amount equal to half your proficiency bonus (rounded down).
  • Press the Hunt (minor). Your maximum number of Control Points is reduced by 1. The first time each turn that you deal damage with a natural weapon, you gain temporary hit points equal to half your proficiency bonus (rounded down).
  • Primal Vigour (major). Your maximum number of Control Points is reduced by 1. You can use Wild Regeneration while not transformed.
  • Cursed Fury (major). Your maximum number of Control Points is reduced by 1. Add half your proficiency bonus (rounded down) to attack rolls with Natural Weapons.
  • Thick Hide (major). Your maximum number of Control Points is reduced by 1. Add half your proficiency bonus (rounded down) to your Armor Class.
  • Swift Hunt (major). Your maximum number of Control Points is reduced by 1. The speed bonus from Feral Speed is doubled.
  • Beast Within (grand). Your maximum number of Control Points is reduced by 1. While not transformed, you gain the benefits of your Key Ability Floor, all of your form's natural weapons, Feral Speed, and all Empowered Transformation bonuses. While transformed and below half your hit point maximum but above 0 hit points, you regain 10 hit points at the start of each of your turns.

Transformation Rules

While transformed you keep your hit points (current, maximum, and temporary), ability scores, saving throws, skill proficiencies, proficiency bonus, damage resistances/immunities/vulnerabilities, and vision. Your key ability cannot drop below your branch's floor (14 at Stage 1, rising to 20 at Stage 10). You replace your natural AC, speed, creature type (Beast), size, and appearance with those of your form. You lose languages, gear proficiencies, class features, equipment, and spellcasting.

Reverting from any transformation inflicts 1 level of Exhaustion; while transformed you ignore all Exhaustion. The curse shifts your alignment while transformed to that of your branch. The curse spreads through your Bite (or Peck/Beak for the Raven branch): a target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your Therianthrope DC or become cursed, gaining Stage 1 of this class at the next Planar Tear unless the curse is first removed by Remove Curse or a similar effect.
